**Daily Devotional**

**April 15**

*8 If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us. 9 If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. 10 If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us. (1 John 1:8-10 KJV)*

We all sin, both Christians and the unsaved (Romans 3:23), but if an unsaved person thinks that they have no sin, then they can’t be saved, as salvation is only for sinners (Matthew 9:13). If a Christian sins, it does not mean he loses his salvation, and God has already forgiven his sins (Hebrews 8:12), but when a Christian sins, it opens up a door to the devil (Romans 6:16). Therefore if a Christian sins, he should ask God for forgiveness (1 John 1:9), so that his sin will not open his flesh up to the devil to come at him with sickness, pain, etc., as the devil comes only to steal, kill and destroy us (John 10:10). The sin does not separate a Christian from God, as Jesus has already paid for the sin, but we don’t want to give the devil an inroad into our lives, so we must confess it and turn from the sinful ways.

The bible is full of scriptures telling us that we have all sinned, so if a person says they have not sinned, they are liars, or don’t believe the bible. We are all born with a sin nature at birth, and that is the reason that we have to be born again (John 3:3), to replace that sin nature with the righteousness of God through our new born again spirit, which is the very Spirit of Jesus (Galatians 4:6). Praise God for our wonderful redemption.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
